text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph argument with intro, body, conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is organized into a recognizable argumentative structure with paragraphs that develop and close the response."},{"evidence":"“I agree with John Lubbock because…”","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a clear central claim early and keeps returning to it."},{"evidence":"“Some people get too comfortable with bad traits…”, “The difference between Joker and Batman…”","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay elaborates its position with explanations and examples rather than only listing ideas."},{"evidence":"“Although some traits…”, “Even though tragic experiences…”","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"The essay uses more complex sentences and subordinating structures to connect and contrast ideas."},{"evidence":"“Trust is like a glass if it breaks it will never be the same”","quality":"figurative language","description":"The essay uses a concrete comparison to make an abstract point more vivid."},{"evidence":"“It depends on ourselves…”, “it is important to…”","quality":"academic tone","description":"The essay sustains a more formal persuasive register appropriate to an argumentative essay."},{"evidence":"consistent focus on character, traits, honesty, trust","quality":"topic control","description":"The essay stays centered on a single line of reasoning without drifting into unrelated listing."}]}
